notes.note: Traced the deferred Task retry admission boundary, committed Session exit read after public orchestration stops and the late join before Git process-group shutdown and EventStore close. A real persisted exit emitted during actual orchestration shutdown kept the home lease while finalization was held, then removed the real worktree and left a settled receipt after SQLite reopen. Startup claim timeout still retains the store and lease. Supervisor platform timing remains separate.

Compared the follow-up with the already reviewed bootstrap callers. The early fence is for deferred Task worktree retries. The subscriber still admits genuine committed Session exits until orchestration stops. It then joins their output and claim effects before Git/SQLite and retains ownership on timeout. The persisted fold uses canonical lifecycle events without transcript bodies. It does not change room permissions, provider transport, or route contracts.
